findings.title: Gaza health ministry reports 10 fatalities and 22 injuries received by hospitals over preceding 48 hours; 12 older fatalities certified in cumulative register
findings.publisher: Palestinian Ministry of Health – Gaza (corroborated by WAFA)
findings.source_publication_time: 12:34 PM (WAFA site local display; timezone not independently verified); ministry Telegram post date 7 November
findings.event_period: preceding 48 hours as reported on 2026-11-07; specific incident dates not established
findings.affected_population_system: Palestinian fatalities, injured patients and Gaza hospitals; recovery and casualty registration
findings.exact_supporting_passage: 10 شهداء(6 شهداء جديد، 2 شهيد متأثرين، 2 شهيد انتشال). ⁠22 أصابة.
findings.confidence_basis: Direct statement from Gaza Ministry of Health channel; WAFA's 7 November article independently republishes overall counts. Incident-level verification not established.
findings.bounded_discovery_context: Discovered from WAFA 7 Nov 12:34 PM Gaza casualty update after prior watch's WAFA landing page showed 7 Nov 09:35 AM as newest Gaza item. Direct Gaza Health Ministry 7 Nov primary statement corroborates headline figures and clarifies that only six of ten fatalities were newly reported deaths; two died of earlier injuries and two bodies were recovered. Twelve additional cumulative deaths reflect retrospective certification, not 12 new 48-hour deaths. Publication shortly before Pacific window start and later visibility indicate a new-to-watch update, not proof of deaths occurring within this hour.
findings.watch_action: Flag for production collector to dedupe against its own official casualty series; no publication or production write.

Prior heartbeat had not seen 12:34 WAFA casualty update even though its publication time marginally predates this Pacific observation window.
